_about.estimator: one out-of-fold prediction per nodule per repeat: the repeat's five test folds together, slice probabilities averaged per nodule
_about.inference: verdict: run-aware interval, mean +/- t(0.975, R-1) * sqrt(repeat term + var of the bootstrap statistic). Repeat term: for a contrast between two arms, whose repeats share only a seed index, (s_X^2 + s_Y^2) / R from each arm's per-repeat values; for two architectures within an arm (same partitions), the variance of the per-repeat differences / R. Beside it, the patient-cluster percentile bootstrap alone (2000 draws, seed 20261002, each draw shared by every arm, architecture and repeat), which holds the trained runs fixed, and a Welch-Satterthwaite version of the run-aware interval as a sensitivity to the df convention; statistic = the mean contrast over repeats
_about.fields: sd_repeats: square root of the repeat variances summed over the two arms, or the SD of the per-repeat differences within an arm. per_repeat of a contrast between arms pairs the repeats by index and is given for reference: the interval, cross_pairs_positive (every repeat of one arm against every repeat of the other) and repeats_positive_any_pairing (lowest and highest count over the one-to-one pairings) do not depend on it; repeats_positive is given only within an arm
_about.sign: positive = the leakier condition looks better
_about.estimator_shift: pooled minus within-fold, per arm; pooling lowers the grouped arms' AUC and raises the random arm's
